Input: `OUTPUT/rds/spe_ruv.rds` (03)  
Output: Supp. Fig. 8 (FigureS8 also .pdf, S8a-S8b) in `OUTPUT/FIGURES/Supplementary/FigureS8` and `OUTPUT/Excel Files/Supplementary/FigureS8`; `OUTPUT/TABLES/SupplementaryFigureS8.xlsx`

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))
endometriosis <- c("Simple endometriosis", "Atypical endometriosis", "Cancer-like endometriosis")

keep <- spe_ruv$Segment == "CD3" & spe_ruv$Category %in% endometriosis
spe_sub <- spe_ruv[, keep]
dge <- spe_to_dge(spe_ruv)[, keep]
```

##### Differential expression
```{r}
design <- model.matrix(~0 + Category + ruv_W1 + ruv_W2 + ruv_W3, data = colData(spe_sub)) %>%
  tidy_design("Category")
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(CLE_SE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Simple_endometriosis,
                              AE_CLE = Cancer_like_endometriosis - Atypical_endometriosis,
                              levels = colnames(design))

# CD3+ AOIs have fewer reads: genes need at least 5 counts in the smallest group
efit <- fit_dge(dge, design, contr.matrix, block = factor(colData(spe_sub)$Patient), min.count = 5)$efit

topTable_CLE_SE <- top_table(efit, "CLE_SE")
topTable_AE_CLE <- top_table(efit, "AE_CLE")
save_tables(list(CD3_CLE_SE = topTable_CLE_SE, CD3_CLE_AE = topTable_AE_CLE), "SupplementaryFigureS8.xlsx")
```

##### Supplementary Figure 8
```{r, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 7.5}
# T-cell genes are labelled from FDR < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 0.56; CD4 and CD8A are always labelled
tcell_genes <- c("CD4", "CD8A", "CCL5", "GZMA", "IL7R", "CCR7", "CTLA4", "CD274", "TIM3", "KLRB1", "BATF", "STAT1", "IL32", "FOXP3",
                 "HLA-B", "GBP5", "CD52", "TRBC1", "CTSW")
always <- c("CD4", "CD8A")

v1 <- plot_volcano(topTable_CLE_SE, union(sig_genes_in(topTable_CLE_SE, tcell_genes, fc = 0.56), always),
                   col_low = "#20854EFF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = c(0, 6),
                   fc_dashed = NULL, left = "SE", right = "CLE", caption_x = 2.8, caption_y = 5.2, max_overlaps = 500)
v2 <- plot_volcano(topTable_AE_CLE, union(sig_genes_in(topTable_AE_CLE, tcell_genes, fc = 0.56), always),
                   col_low = "#0073C2FF", col_high = "#EFC000FF", xlim = c(-4, 4), ylim = c(0, 6),
                   fc_dashed = NULL, left = "AE", right = "CLE", caption_x = 2.8, caption_y = 5.2)
# same size, letters and captions as Supplementary Figure 5
FigureS8 <- v1 + v2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = letter_size(15)))
FigureS8

save_plot(FigureS8, "FigureS8.pdf", width = 15, height = 7.5)
save_plot(FigureS8, "FigureS8.svg", width = 15, height = 7.5)

# Single panels
save_plot(v1, "FigureS8a.svg", width = 4, height = 4)
save_plot(v2, "FigureS8b.svg", width = 4, height = 4)
save_source_data(volcano_source(v1), "FigureS8a")
save_source_data(volcano_source(v2), "FigureS8b")
```
